title: The Poké Mart: res/field/shops/poke_mart.json
description: Shop 255, every Pokémon Center's first clerk, whose list grows with the player's badges: Scrcmd_Shop_CallFriendlyShopBuy's ShopUI_LoadPokeMartItems picks a tier by BADGE_SHOP_DAT_IDS (src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c), files 0 to 5 of archive a/2/8/2, which tools/data/shop_data.py packs. Each item costs its price in its own data (res/items/<item>/data.json), less with the Bargain Pass Power. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

name.description: Where the shop is, for people and editors; the game doesn't read it

tiers.description: The tiers in file order, one per file of BADGE_SHOP_DAT_IDS

badges.description: The badge counts the tier is for, as BADGE_SHOP_DAT_IDS gives them; the packer checks them, and changing which counts a tier is for is changing the C table

items.description: The items in menu order, at most 45 (ShopUIWork's entries)
